=============================================================
 LionClient Redesigned - installation
-------------------------------------------------------------
 1. In this folder, double-click BUILD.BAT (or open Command
    Prompt here and run:  BUILD.BAT)
    - The script auto-finds javac.exe on your PATH and then
      locates jar.exe in your real JDK folder (it knows to
      look past Oracle's javapath shim at
      C:\Program Files\Common Files\Oracle\Java\javapath\
      which does NOT contain jar.exe).
    - If jar.exe is still not found (rare), BUILD.BAT falls
      back to PowerShell's built-in zip - a .jar is just a
      .zip with a manifest, so Forge/Fabric/java -jar still
      accept it.
 2. The batch compiles the UI framework + bootstrap stubs
    and produces build\client-patched.jar.
 3. Put client-patched.jar into your mods\ folder (Forge/
    Fabric/LabyMod) or run it standalone with
        java -jar build\client-patched.jar
 Press RIGHT_SHIFT in-game to open the new ClickGUI.
=============================================================
